title: MONTAGE M Control List: destination tables
source: MONTAGE M Data List (montage_m_dl_H0.pdf, Yamaha), PDF page index == printed page number for these sections

value_semantics.true: O in PDF: destination is available in that context

controller_box_destination.description: Destination numbers used by the Controller Set Destination parameter of the Part Controller Boxes (1p 05 bb 04, range 1-413) and of the Common/AD Controller Boxes (06 05 bb 04, range 1-393). Value 0 = Off.

columns.awm_normal: Multi Part / AWM Part (AWM2 normal part)
columns.common_audio: Common / Audio Part (Performance common and A/D controller boxes)

footnotes.*1: This is available only for Part 1.
footnotes.*2: For Grid Mode, only Lane 1 Sequence 1 is affected. (For Common, Super Knob Lane Sequence 1 is affected.)
footnotes.*3: For Grid Mode, only Decay 1 is affected.

controller_box_destination.depth_range_note: The Control List gives no per-destination depth or range. Depth is set per box by 'Controller Set Ratio' (-128..+127), 'Polarity' (Unipolar/Bipolar) and the curve parameters (see control_curves.json).

lfo_box_destination.description: Destination numbers used by the Part LFO 'LFO Destination 1-3' parameters (1p 00 07 12/16/1A, documented range 0-69 'Refer to LFO Box Destination of Control List'). The printed table runs to 88 (70-88 are FM-X and AN-X entries beyond the documented 0-69 range; listed as printed).

columns.audio_part: Audio Part (printed as '-' for every row)

key_controller_box_destination.description: Destination values used by the Key Controller Box (per Part, 4 sets: address 1p 00 09 00, each set has Switch / Destination 1-58 / Curve Bank / Curve Type / Curve Param 1-2 / Polarity / Ratio). Value 0 = Off in the printed table; the SysEx range on p.244 is 1-58.

columns.awm_drum: AWM Drum ('-' for all rows except 0)

key_controller_box_destination.category_note: Category is a merged cell in the PDF (Common, AWM TG, FM-X TG, AN-X TG, AN-X TG 2); it is repeated here on every row.
